name: afterword
description: Spoken replies for Codex with local Qwen3-TTS: off by default, per-session voices, triggered only by a <say> tag.

interface.shortDescription: Speak <say> lines aloud with a local voice
interface.longDescription: Speaks the <say> lines in Codex replies with local Qwen3-TTS voices, one voice per session, off until you turn it on. Needs the AfterWord daemon (uv run afterword serve).
